title: VIGIL contributed bundle
description: What one contributor submits: their run records, plus the one identity field the system needs. ATTRIBUTION LIVES HERE AND NOWHERE ELSE. Run records carry no install-id, machine-id or repo-hash by design, so records cannot be correlated to each other or to a person. Submitting a bundle means opening a pull request, which is already a non-anonymous act, so naming the contributor at this layer costs no privacy the PR did not already spend. Do not push identity down into the records to make aggregation easier — that trade is the whole thing this design refuses. NOTE: `records` is deliberately opaque here. A cross-file $ref would force the validator to fetch a second schema to decide, and privacy_gate.py fails closed on any $ref it cannot resolve locally. Instead the gate validates the envelope with THIS schema and every element against run-record.schema.json, in that order — see check_bundle().

contributor.description: The submitting handle. Charset follows GitHub's rule so it cannot carry a sentence.

records.x-validated-by: privacy_gate.check_bundle — each element is validated against run-record.schema.json in code. Deliberately not a cross-file $ref: this gate refuses to pass anything it had to fetch to decide. Declared here so 'validated elsewhere' cannot be mistaken for 'not validated' by a reader or by the validator.
